svg.title: Kitchen lighting: 12 V RGB best-practice breadboard proof of concept
svg.desc: Nano 33 IoT, two TC4427ACPA drivers, three IRFZ44NPBF MOSFETs and barrel jack J0. A soldered pigtail connects J0 pin 1 directly to strip positive, bypassing all breadboard contacts. Row 40 is unused; a41 green, a42 red and a43 blue are the strip returns. Return current still passes through the breadboard; only a short strip segment is connected.
svg.text: RGB strip · ≤25 cm · ≤0.30 A total LED current

g.title: Link left and right +12 V rails
Link left and right ground rails

svg.title: Centre-positive DC connector
svg.desc: The minus sign connects to the outer sleeve, and the plus sign connects to the centre pin.

g.title: Soldered pigtail from actual J0 pin 1 to strip +; not a breadboard jumper
Nano D3 → U1 pin 2 / red; HIGH=ON
Nano D5 → U1 pin 4 / green; HIGH=ON
Nano D6 → U2 pin 2 / blue; HIGH=ON
